## Safety

- [ ] Does not write directly to `collection.anki2`.
- [ ] Does not package profile-derived data, indexes, logs, or credentials.
- [ ] Does not add telemetry or transmit card/query content.
- [ ] Collection mutations use supported, undoable Anki operations.
- [ ] Smart and Exact remain usable when Semantic is absent, unsupported, or
      preparing.
- [ ] Any new external asset has a pinned source, integrity check, license, and
      notice.
